case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for laying out your labour and steel costs so openly, and for the pride you take in your foundry's work for us. We would like to answer in the same spirit, as one family company to another.

Option A is the package we can approve. It lets your shop plan its work on a clear price and a payment term you can rely on, and the points below show why we think it is fair for both sides.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 125.45; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 126.17; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Please tell us what you would need from us to confirm Option A.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. Furthermore, we checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Maintaining your preferred 30-day payment terms, we propose a unit price of €134.50, which balances your verified data with the realities of our production costs. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €134.50 per unit. 

For our main Angebot, we offer a price of €137.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You asked us to understand the necessity of your figures, and we have taken your labour and steel costs seriously. We are glad the quality record and the notice period held up for you.

Your latest proposal still sits well above what we can approve.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 126.75; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 127.47; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 128.20; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. For a family foundry that held the old price for us in a hard year, that is a clean, quick answer on a price both sides can plan with.

Just before I close: what would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your revised offer and your recognition of our long-standing relationship, which has always meant a great deal to our family foundry over the years. However, your proposed price remains significantly below what is necessary to cover our increased costs. 

To move closer to an agreement, we can offer a unit price of €136.20 for your preferred 30-day payment terms and an effective date of 1 April 2027. Under our updated Angebot, we present a price of €136.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal reflects our continued dedication to working together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Best regards

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your constructive offer of 14-day payment terms, which we are willing to accept. In exchange for this faster payment, we are prepared to make a substantial concession on the unit price. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. However, for this agreement, we propose a price of €134.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. 

Please understand that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This offer remains valid for 30 days. We value the long-standing relationship between our companies and look forward to continuing our collaboration.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, given our shared history and deep roots in this region. We appreciate your revised offer and the option to maintain the 14-day payment terms. In response to your step towards us, we are prepared to lower our price to €133.50 for these terms. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This represents a fair compromise that respects both our need to cover our increased expenses and your need for a reliable price. For your records, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Please understand that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €133.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
